questions: Section 2 says three preferred classes sit above Standard but does not say where they are offered. Are Preferred and Standard Plus available on a whole life policy of $250,000 for a 55-year-old, or is any product, face-amount or age restriction applied before a preferred class can be awarded?

The file declares no avocation but notes the applicant is a season-ticket holder at the local rugby club. Is spectator attendance at a sport treated as an avocation under section 10, or is it disregarded?

Section 16 refers combinations of cardiac risk factors to underwriting judgement. Where every individual reading falls inside its zero-debit band but blood pressure (129/71 untreated) and lipids (total cholesterol 214, ratio 4.2) both sit in the upper part of those bands, does that combination attract any debit or bar a preferred class, or is it rated as zero?
